_about: The Same subject list beside each Review card (kb/_build_exhibits_review.py): every C-ID, CCN and M-ID title in the subject of the card's main local course, as [id, title, colleges, units low, units high, system], the most colleges first, keyed by the discipline's name (or the SUBJ4, or "TOP nnnn" when only the course's TOP code places it). A card names its key in `subject` and the course it came from in `subject_course`.
